integrity.prior_comparison: The theorem is not implied by the inspected global generalized-dominance or weighted-skew sufficient criteria, as proved by a concrete four-dimensional separation example.
integrity.verification: An explicit analytical proof is included. A standard-library Python script checks 660 rational instances and two exact model examples, without substituting finite tests for universal proof.

scientific_limitations: The all-growth-rate weak-graph property is not an equivalence for any single fixed growth vector.
For arbitrary singular matrices the graph-level theorem does not classify actual connecting trajectories.
Two-vertex component criteria are sufficient but not necessary for acyclicity.
Historical priority could be affected by unindexed analogous network-decomposition results; the three-species sharpness example is previously known.
title: Feedback-component localization of Lotka–Volterra weak cycles and a sharp two-species cutoff
